Build clean now, exit 0.

Two real bugs, rest deprecation noise from bump:

- `src/core/options.js`: read `options.retries`, new bundler pass `retryCount`. Fixed key name.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js`: strict check threw on `undefined`, new config loader leaves unset flags undefined instead of `false`. Now treat `undefined` as disabled, same as `false`.

8 deprecation warnings remain (Buffer(), fs.exists, punycode, etc) — noise, not errors, safe to leave or schedule separate cleanup.
